messages.text:
"Make me a 2D pixel art story mode game with a big open world I can explore freely. The world has different areas like a village, forest, desert, caves and dungeons. There is a main story with chapters and quests, plus side quests from NPCs I can talk to. I can fight enemies and bosses, collect items and coins, level up, and get stronger weapons and armor. Add secrets and hidden places to discover, a save system so I can continue later, and simple touch controls for mobile. Make sure the controls are smooth and easy to use, and the menus and UI look clean and polished. The player makes their own choices in the story, and the choices change what happens next. There are 8 endings in total: 5 bad endings, 2 good endings, and 1 secret ending that is hard to find.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

Implementation approach:
- Canvas 2D rendering, pixel art style. Tiles 16px, scale up 3x (or dynamic scale for mobile). Camera follows player. 
- Procedural-ish generation with hand-authored structure: I'll generate the map with code (deterministic, seeded) placing biomes: village with houses, forest with trees and paths, desert with dunes and cactus, water lakes, mountains blocking edges. Caves/dungeons as separate generated maps with fixed layouts.
- Entities: NPCs, enemies spawned per biome, items on ground, chests.
- Combat: real-time action combat (player swings sword, contact/touch damage; enemies chase in range). Simpler and smooth for touch. Weapon decides damage/range/speed/cooldown. Armor reduces damage. XP/levels increase HP and damage.
- Bosses: e.g., forest boss (Elder Treant), desert boss (Sand Wurm), cave boss (Crystal Golem), dungeon boss (Lich). Gate story progression.
- Story: chapters 1..6 with quests; main story dialogue with choices at key points affecting flags. 8 endings: 5 bad (e.g., die to final boss in some states? no—endings triggered by story choices & flags), 2 good, 1 secret (requires collecting 7 hidden shards + secret path).
- Side quests from NPCs: fetch quests, kill quests, escort-lite? Keep simple: talk, get objective, complete, reward.
- Save system: localStorage autosave + manual save at campfire/inn; slot saves. Save on exit too.
- Touch controls: virtual joystick (left), attack button (A), interact/confirm button (B), menu button. Also keyboard for desktop: WASD/arrows, J/Z attack, K/X interact, Enter menu. Smooth movement with acceleration.
- UI: clean HUD (HP bar, XP bar, coins, chapter/quest tracker), pause menu, inventory/equipment, dialogue box with choices, toasts, minimap, quest log, endings gallery.
- Secrets: hidden chests behind fake walls, invisible paths, cracks, a locked door needing a key, secret area in cave. Discovered secrets list.

I made an error in bandit: `px(g, 5, H => H, 0, 0, 0);` — that's invalid JS? Actually `H => H` inside call args is an arrow function passed as y coordinate — `px(g,5, fn, 0,0,0)` would do g.fillStyle then fillRect(x=5, y=fn,...) → fn coerced to string → NaN → no draw, no crash. Actually the statement `px(g, 5, H => H, 0, 0, 0);` — the arrow function parameter shadows nothing; inside the arrow, `H => H` is fine (H is the param). But wait — the arrow param H shadows the const H in TDZ... no, the arrow body `H` refers to its own parameter. So `H => H` doesn't touch outer H. No TDZ error. fillRect with y=arrowFunction → NaN → silently ignored? fillRect with NaN throws? Canvas fillRect with non-finite values is silently ignored per spec (it's a no-op). Actually per HTML spec, if any argument is NaN/Infinite, the method returns without drawing (no exception). Good but ugly. Let me clean it anyway.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D pixel-art story-driven open-world action RPG ("EMBERFALL") in the browser: free exploration (village, forest, desert, caves, dungeon), chaptered main story + NPC side quests, real-time combat with 4 bosses, items/coins/leveling, weapons/armor, secrets, save system, smooth touch controls, polished menus/UI, story choices with consequences, and exactly 8 endings (5 bad, 2 good, 1 secret/hard-to-find).

## Requirements
- Build now, no clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at the end.
- Deliver a complete playable game (single-page browser game; vanilla JS, no build step).
- Touch controls for mobile plus keyboard; smooth movement; clean polished UI; save system to continue later.

## Decisions
- Game name "EMBERFALL"; village "Bramblebrook"; protagonist "Ashe" (fixed name).
- Plain classic `<script>` files sharing global scope (no ES modules) so it runs from file://; many small JS modules (each write call kept small due to output token limits; use write tool for new files, shell `node --check` to verify).
- Single 220×220 tile overworld map + dungeon sub-maps (cave1 Barrow, cave2 Deep Hollow, keep Ember Keep, grot Seagrot, grove Hidden Grove) in `MAPS` registry; deterministic seeded worldgen.
- Real-time action combat (sword arc swings, roll with i-frames), hopper/flutter/lunge/archer/shooter/slam mob AIs, 4 bosses (warden, sovereign, deepking, marshal) with phases/telegraphs/minions.
- Story flags in `G.flags`; hope 0–6 stat; 8 endings keyed: ash, crown, dark, cold, deep (bad), keeper, shared (good), unwritten (secret; needs 7 Ember Shards + all bosses spared + Shrine of Mornings awakened).
- Save: localStorage `emberfall_save1` (base64 reveal maps) + meta `emberfall_meta1` (endings found, settings).
- WebAudio synth SFX + pattern music per area; procedural pixel sprites via offscreen canvases (no external art); 'Press Start 2P' via Google Fonts with monospace fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- All ~34 project files written under `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/`: index.html (with ordered script tags), css/{base,hud,dialog,card,menus,touch}.css, and js/ modules (core, save, audio, input, sprites_core/tiles/decos/chars/mobs/icons, items, mobs_data, story_core, dlg_village, dlg_world, dlg_story, dlg_boss, dlg_final, worldgen, world_village, world_tags, world_caves, world_keep, ent_core, ent_mobs, ent_fx, boss, game_core, game_flow, game_dialog, game_ui, game_menus, game_render, game_render2, main).
- `node --check` passes on all JS files.
- Fixed during integration: missing script tags, Input.axis release drift, gate sets `F(gate+'_open')`, cave2 arena carve + shaft portal moved to (24,28), player death clears boss intro trigger via `Game.goto`, dialog `pick` supports `end:true` (endings), finale choices use `end:true`, minimap aspect, Rocco fight spawn in `Game.checkMenus`, added missing decos (moss/fence/table), `regionAt` Ember Keep check reorder, removed broken lines in dlg_village/dlg_boss/sprites_mobs/game_menus.

### Active
- Just wrote headless smoke test `/tmp/opencode/smoke.js` (vm sandbox with stub DOM/canvas/rAF/localStorage) that boots `Game.init()`, runs prologue dialog, walks/attacks, tours all maps, fights/spares all 4 bosses, runs finale + ending, save/load, shops/menus, render passes; prints errors.

### Blocked
- Smoke test has not been run yet; expected to surface runtime bugs that must be fixed (remaining known-risk areas: dialog choice flow, boss scene progression, `Game.showEnding` DOM reuse, setupStick firstElementChild stub, `UI.onMapChange` before UI.build order).

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/smoke.js` and fix all reported STEP/FRAME/LOAD errors until zero errors.
2. Manually re-verify end-to-end critical paths in code if smoke reveals gaps (prologue origin choice → maxhp via `Game.applyOrigin`; `advanceQuest('dawn')` completes; keep gate/portal req `got('keep_open')`; seagrot req lantern; grove req `grove_open`; cave2 shaft req `chapter>=3` and `deepshaft`).
3. Write `emberfall/README.md` (how to run: open `emberfall/index.html` or `python3 -m http.server`; controls; features; assumptions).
4. Final report to user summarizing the game, controls, 8 endings and their conditions, and assumptions made.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/index.html`: entry point; script load order matters (core → … → main).
- `/tmp/opencode/smoke.js`: headless smoke harness to run next; edit/re-run until clean.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/game_core.js`: Game init/loop/goto/tags/bosses/chapters/endings glue.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/game_flow.js`: interact/camp/well/shop glue, rocco fight, gather mechanics.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/game_dialog.js`: Dlg runner (typewriter, choices, `steps`/`end` handling).
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/dlg_boss.js` + `js/boss.js`: boss scenes, `bossAfterSteps`, spare/slay rewards.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/dlg_final.js`: finale choices + `doEnding(key)`.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/worldgen.js` + `world_tags.js` + `world_caves.js` + `world_keep.js`: world/portal/chest/boss-tag layout and coordinates.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/game_ui.js` + `game_menus.js`: HUD, touch controls, Title, menus/shops.
- `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w/emberfall/js/game_render.js` + `game_render2.js`: rendering, lighting, weather, Title.bg.

## Important Context
- Output token limits forced very small tool calls; keep future write calls small (< ~2KB) and prefer `node --check` after edits.
- Coordinate conventions: face 0=down,1=up,2=left,3=right; tile 16px; world tile coords used in tags/zones, px coords for entities.
- Endings conditions: ash=marshal spared+pact offered choice; crown=claim; dark=feed Hollow (needs `deepvoice` flag from cave2 tablet); cold=shatter; deep=descend now when `deepvoice` && hope<3 (ch3_after branch); keeper=offer to kiln (hope<4 or no spared deepking); shared=offer with hope>=4 && `spared_deepking`; unwritten=`shrine_awake` (7 shards at grove shrine; grove requires spared warden).
- Shop/forge: Bruna forges dawn blade (3 emberstone + 80c) and gifts Emberedge when `shards>=7 && spared_all`; hope>=4 gives 15% shop discount.
- All changes are uncommitted working-tree files in `emberfall/` (repo `/home/runner/work/My2w/My2w`).
